notes: Named foreign military installations, host facilities with a documented foreign military presence, and named military support sites. Operating describes the listing or presence described by the cited source. Where the source is a historical map the status is unknown.

Sending country records the military presence. It is distinct from legal ownership. Site title and ownership shares are unknown in this table, so ownerCountry is null and owners is empty. For the UK Sovereign Base Areas, CYP refers to island geography and GBR records the source-reported jurisdiction.
Coordinates are entered only for a sourced facility location. A null geometry means the exact site has not been established. Geographic placement and military presence do not establish title.
